summary: Kanzhun Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing its annual general meeting (AGM) scheduled for June 25, 2026, in Beijing. The filing includes a circular, notice, and proxy form for resolutions such as proposed amendments to the memorandum and articles of association. The board recommends voting in favor. Record dates are May 21, 2026. This is a routine corporate governance notice, not a special situation. No deal terms are present. The foreign private issuer is fulfilling reporting obligations under the 1934 Act.
